The neritic zone is the shallow part of the ocean over the continental shelf where sunlight reaches the seafloor (allowing photosynthesis) and nutrients are often upwelled, supporting high productivity.  
The bathyl zone is deeper and darker, the pelagic zone refers to the whole water column (not specifically nutrient-rich and sunlit), and the benthyl zone refers to the bottom substrate regardless of depth.  

Final answer: (B)
